thread:
maria: noticed a spike in SSO failures for a handful of AAD tenants after an IdP cert rotation. ACS logs show 'invalid NameID characters' and affected users have non-ascii emails (e.g. josé@partner.com). Anyone seen XML NameID charset issues before?
aj: can you paste the ACS error + a redacted snippet?
maria: ACS: saml/acs: processing error: invalid NameID characters (NameID='josé@partner.com')
redacted snippet: <NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress">josé@partner.com</NameID>
devon: sounds like xml parser or the SP lib is coercing bytes. What SP lib version is prod on?
maria: prod sp-auth v2.3.1, we have v2.4.0 in staging. v2.4 had some unicode/xml fixes iirc.
samir: confirmed v2.4.0 fixed nameid utf8 handling. also found we rolled an edge-proxy cookie sanitizer last month that rewrites Cookie header via a regex that isn't utf8-safe. If cookie values have multibyte chars it can corrupt multipart boundaries and truncate base64 SAMLResponse -> parser sees invalid chars. repro: POST to /sso/saml/acs with Cookie: user=josé will hit it.
aj: immediate plan?
maria: 1) roll back cookie sanitizer to utf8-safe version, 2) promote sp-auth v2.4.0 to canary then prod, 3) notify affected customers with workaround (map NameID to ascii attr), 4) follow-up postmortem and add unit tests.
aj: i'll open PRs for rollback + sp-auth release and run canary.
samir: i'll scan KMS logs but assertions use our SP key locally so KMS unlikely implicated; i'll open incident follow-up and check if any encrypted assertions failed decrypt.
deploy-bot: system: rolled back cookie-sanitizer on edge-proxy at 2024-06-18T15:02:00Z per rollback request #2145.
maria: after rollback and canary bump, auths for impacted tenants look healthy. closing thread, will send PMs and a short postmortem later :thumbsup:
